name: AWS Explorer
description: Browse and run actions on AWS S3, EMR, and SQS using your local authenticated AWS CLI (no credentials stored in the plugin).

settings.title: AWS CLI command
settings.description: Binary path or command used to invoke the AWS CLI (e.g. aws, C:\Program Files\Amazon\AWSCLIV2\aws.exe, or uvx --from awscli aws).

settings.title: Run AWS CLI inside WSL
settings.description: When enabled on Windows, runs commands via wsl.exe -- <awsBin> to use the WSL AWS CLI and credentials.

settings.title: Default profile (--profile)
settings.description: Initial AWS CLI profile when opening the explorer. Leave empty to use the AWS CLI default.

settings.title: Default region (--region)
settings.description: Initial AWS region (e.g. us-east-1, sa-east-1). Leave empty to use the profile region.

settings.title: Command timeout (seconds)
settings.description: Maximum wait time per AWS CLI command.

settings.title: Language / Idioma
settings.description: UI language for AWS Explorer (auto follows Orca's locale).

cover.alt: AWS Explorer inside Orca browsing S3 buckets and previewing a JSON object.

screenshots.alt: S3 bucket list on the left and prefix browser with JSON object preview, presigned URL, upload, and delete actions on the right.
screenshots.caption: S3: browse buckets and prefixes, preview/save text & JSON, presign, upload, and delete.

screenshots.alt: EMR clusters list on the left and cluster details with Spark steps and step actions on the right.
screenshots.caption: EMR: monitor clusters and steps, submit new steps, cancel running steps, or terminate clusters.

screenshots.alt: SQS queues list on the left and FIFO queue counters with peeked JSON messages on the right.
screenshots.caption: SQS: inspect queue counts, peek messages without hiding them, send Standard/FIFO messages, and purge.
